newsitem.title: BRAZIL: France's Scor to open office in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: France's Scor to open office in Brazil.

text.p: France's largest reinsurance firm, Scor S.A., will open an office in Rio de Janeiro on Wednesday, positioning itself to enter the promising Brazilian insurance market, an official said.
"We're opening an office in Rio because of the opening of the market," said Alain Saint-Dizier, the future director of the Brazilian office.

A company spokesman, who asked not to be named, said the representative office's main function will be to study Brazil's insurance market ahead of the passage of legislation opening the sector to private capital.
"They want to be here to learn about the Brazilian market before it is finally opened," the spokesman said.
Scor, the world's sixth-largest reinsurer, plans to reinsure oil platforms and refineries in Brazil, he said.

The French company and other foreign and local reinsurance firms will be looking for opportunities stemming from the privatization of the country's telecom, power and transportation sectors, all likely to become key clients for reinsurance firms.
"They will need to hire private insurance firms because they will not be backed any more by the government's assets when an accident happens," the spokesman said.
Scor, which reinsures France's space program, will be the second foreign reinsurer to open an office in Brazil.
In August, Swiss Reinsurance Co opened an office Sao Paulo to conduct market studies and make contacts with possible future clients.
